```java
import java.util.*;

public class GoodCode {
    public void processRequest(String input) {
        // Good: Using checked cast with validation
        List<String> list = Arrays.asList(input.split(","));
        List<String> filteredList = new ArrayList<>();
        
        for (String item : list) {
            try {
                // Good: Validate input before casting
                if (!item.matches("\\d+")) {
                    continue; // Skip invalid items
                }
                
                int intValue = Integer.parseInt(item);
                filteredList.add(String.valueOf(intValue));
            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                // Skip invalid items
            }
        }
        
        // Output the result
        System.out.println("Valid items: " + filteredList);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        GoodCode goodCode = new GoodCode();
        goodCode.processRequest("1,2,3,abc");
    }
}
```
